hotel_by_day.6: Holiday Inn Express Osaka City Centre Midosuji

expert.name: Aiko
expert.quote: This is the long way through Japan, down the Inland Sea and across to Shikoku, where very few visitors go.
expert.tip: Stay on Miyajima until the light goes if you can. The gate lit at dusk with the day crowds gone is the better version of that photograph.

summary: Eleven days from Tokyo down the Inland Sea and across to Shikoku: Mount Fuji and Lake Kawaguchi, Kyoto and Nara, Himeji castle, Korakuen garden, the Hiroshima peace park, the island shrine at Miyajima, Matsuyama castle and the Naruto whirlpools before Kobe.
included: Included: 10 nights with daily breakfast; bullet trains and the ferry to Shikoku; private airport transfers; Tokyo sightseeing tour; Arakurayama Sengen park and a Lake Kawaguchi boat ride; Iyashi no Sato Nenba, Shiraito falls and the Toyota Automobile Museum; Kyoto sightseeing tour; Nara sightseeing tour; Himeji castle; Okayama sightseeing tour; Kurashiki, Hiroshima walking tour and Itsukushima shrine; Matsuyama castle with the cable car and Ishite-ji; Kotohira, Ritsurin and the Naruto bridge; Kobe earthquake memorial museum.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan visa fees; lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
